rows.text: The key to piloting Golbez, Crystal Collector is understanding its core engine: Golbez surveils whenever an artifact enters and recurs creature cards to hand at your end step if you have 4+ artifacts. At 8+ artifacts, he drains every opponent for that creature's power, turning recurring high-power artifact creatures into an inevitable clock.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Rhystic Study, Cyclonic Rift, Demonic Tutor. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
